name: MMSI-Video-Bench_lmmseval
description:
MMSI-Video-Bench
	

A video-based spatial intelligence benchmark for evaluating Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

MMSI-Video-Bench tests models on:

Spatial reasoning
Motion understanding  
Planning and prediction
Cross-video reasoning

├── data/

├── frames.zip                         # Extracted video frames
├── ref_images.zip                     #… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/oscarqjh/MMSI-Video-Bench_lmmseval.
reputation: A recent video-based MLLM benchmark focused on spatial and motion reasoning; adopted by a small but growing community working on multimodal spatial understanding.
